summary: feat(integrations): add Claude Code baseline profile and tests

decisions.problem: Claude Code was not supported as a declarative client profile, lacking automated config generation, skill installation, and documentation.
decisions.choice: Add CLAUDE_CODE profile to ALL_PROFILES with .mcp.json, mcpServers, .claude/skills/commitecho/SKILL.md, and CLAUDE.md. Update CLI help, schema descriptions, and domain models.
decisions.rationale: Enables single-command setup for Claude Code while preserving existing .mcp.json entries and CLAUDE.md project instructions.

decisions.problem: Real stdio launch and handshake tests only checked codex and antigravity explicitly.
decisions.choice: Extend real stdio MCP handshake tests to cover all profiles including claude_code and copilot_vscode, and test full change lifecycle with client='claude_code'.
decisions.rationale: Validates that generated configuration for all profiles produces a working stdio MCP server without PYTHONPATH dependencies.
